marks.gloss_en: הכי אמר רבי יוחנן -- an amoraic dictum adduced for his deferring at the synagogue door and not on the road (no support kind names הכי אמר)
ועד השתא לאו מר אנא? -- and until now was I not master? [why defer only now]
הכי אמר רבי יוחנן: אין מכבדין אלא בפתח שיש בה מזוזה (= p_rj_utterance)
Ravin's donkey went ahead of Abaye's, and he did not say to him 'let the master go'
מאי שנא רובא -- דאכתי לא כליא ברכה, מיעוטא נמי לא כליא ברכה! -- if for the majority [one waits] because the blessing is not yet finished, for the minority too it is not finished
שאני אומר: כל העונה אמן יותר מדאי אינו אלא טועה (= p_oneh_yoter_midai_toeh)
Rav Chisda: because I say, whoever answers amen more than is proper is merely mistaken
the baraita: nor with dirty hands
(entertained) a doorway that has a mezuza, yes; one that has none, no
Rav: those reclining may not eat anything until the one who breaks bread tastes
that a person must say [a teaching] in his teacher's language
the baraita: two wait for each other at the dish
Rabba bar bar Chana: the one who breaks bread may not break until the amen ends from the mouths of the responders
דתנן: מאכילין את העניים דמאי ואת האכסניא דמאי -- a mishnah citation (no support kind names a דתנן; svara stands in): demai is fit for a poor man
הא לא חזי ליה! -- but [demai] is not fit for him [so how does eating it count for a zimmun]?
כיון דאי בעי מפקר להו לנכסיה והוי עני, וחזי ליה (= p_mafkir_nechasav)
since, if he wished, he could declare his property ownerless and be a poor man, and it would be fit for him
אמר ליה שמואל: אילו מייתו לי ארדילייא וגוזלייא לאבא, מי לא אכלינן? -- if delicacies were brought, would we not eat? [so 'we have eaten' does not hold]
Rav Shimi bar Chiyya came and was hurrying and eating
והלכתא: גדול מברך, אף על גב דאתא לבסוף
Rav's students: a great man has come who will bless for us
the baraita: one does not answer a snatched amen, nor a cut amen, nor an orphaned amen
Ben Azzai: whoever answers an orphaned amen -- his children will be orphans
שנאמר מעשר מן המעשר -- a tithe from the tithe, not teruma gedola and a tithe from the tithe
first tithe that [the Levite] took first while on the stalks is exempt from teruma gedola
וכדרבי אבהו -- in accordance with R' Abbahu [in Reish Lakish's name]: first tithe taken on the stalks is exempt from teruma gedola
שנאמר מעשר מן המעשר -- a tithe from the tithe, not teruma gedola and a tithe from the tithe
אמר ליה רב פפא לאביי: אי הכי, אפילו הקדימו בכרי נמי! -- if 'a tithe from the tithe' excludes teruma gedola, then even tithe taken first from the pile should be exempt
